title: Most Studied Languages on Duolingo
desc: Duolingo's global order of the 10 most popular languages to study during its 2025 reporting period. The company publishes their order, not learner counts.

source.name: Duolingo Language Report 2025
source.note: The report covers learners who studied on Duolingo from October 1, 2024 through September 30, 2025. It publishes the top 10 order, not exact learner counts. Country-level rankings omit countries with fewer than 5,000 learners.
